blocks.html: Which the said Barrau, the uncle, well showed at the exhibition [exhibition: the presenting of the prisoner to him] that was made to him of the prisoner his nephew, as well before the said Judge of Rieux as afterwards in the Court: for, seeing him in the hands of Justice, the heavy irons on his legs, and in danger of his life, he began incontinently to weep and to groan bitterly.
